Trigger.QAFE_FORM3_overridden:TriggerText:
/*
Check whether the entered course_no exists in the database.
*/
DECLARE
 CURSOR c_get_course is SELECT course_no
 FROM course
 WHERE course.course_no = :section.course_no;
 v_invalid BOOLEAN;
 x number;
BEGIN
 OPEN c_get_course;
 FETCH c_get_course INTO :course.course_no;
 v_invalid := c_get_course%NOTFOUND;
 IF v_invalid THEN
 MESSAGE('This course does not exist in the database.');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

if :course.cost < 5 then
 message('Course cost has to be greater than 5');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;

if get_item_property('STUDENTCOUNT', VISIBLE) = 'TRUE' then
 set_item_property('STUDENTCOUNT', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE); 
else
 set_item_property('STUDENTCOUNT', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_TRUE); 
end if;

select count(sec.section_id) into :course.sectioncount 
from section sec 
where sec.course_no = :course.course_no;

select count(enr.student_id) into :course.studentcount 
from enrollment enr, section sec 
where sec.course_no = :course.course_no and sec.section_id = enr.section_id;
